theorem probe_nv_strategy :
    ∃ G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game Unit Unit Unit Unit,
      Nonempty (QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G) := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ _ => 1, fun _ _ => zero_le_one, by simp, fun _ _ _ _ => true⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact
    { Alice := Unit
      Bob := Unit
      state := ⟨1, Matrix.PosSemidef.one, by simp⟩
      aliceMeasurement := fun _ => ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one, by simp⟩
      bobMeasurement := fun _ => ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one, by simp⟩ }
